description.en: Learn the dishes Kenyans love, order at a hoteli or kibanda, say what you like and ask for the bill.
description.so: Baro cuntooyinka Kenyaanku jecel yihiin, wax ka dalbo hoteli ama kibanda, sheeg waxaad jeceshahay oo weydii biilka.

body.en: Ugali (stiff maize porridge) with sukuma wiki (greens) is the everyday meal in most Kenyan homes. You eat ugali with your right hand: roll a small ball and use it to scoop the stew. Chapati is a treat for weekends and holidays, and nyama choma (grilled goat or beef) is what friends share on a Saturday.
body.so: Ugali (soor adag oo galley ah) iyo sukuma wiki (caleen cagaaran) waa cuntada maalinlaha ah ee guryaha Kenya intooda badan. Ugali waxaa lagu cunaa gacanta midig: kubbad yar samee oo ku qaado maraqa. Chapati (sabaayad) waa cunto gaar ah oo la cuno fasaxyada iyo dhammaadka toddobaadka, nyama choma (hilib ari ama lo' oo la dubay) waa waxa saaxiibbadu wadaagaan Sabtida.

body.en: In Kenya a hoteli is usually a small eating place, and a kibanda is a small roadside food stall. Ordering with Nipe... (Give me...) is normal, not rude; add tafadhali to be polite. Ningependa... (I would like...) is softer. When you finish, say Lete bili or Bili, tafadhali.
body.so: Kenya, hoteli badanaa waa meel yar oo wax lagu cuno, kibanda-na waa dukaan cunto oo yar oo waddada dhinaceeda ah. In aad ku dalbato Nipe... (I sii...) waa caadi, edeb darro ma aha; ku dar tafadhali si aad edeb u muujiso. Ningependa... (Waxaan jeclaan lahaa...) way ka jilicsan tahay. Markaad dhammayso, dheh Lete bili ama Bili, tafadhali.

examples.sw: Nipe chai na mandazi mbili, tafadhali.
examples.en: Give me tea and two mandazis, please.
examples.so: Shaah iyo laba mandaasi i sii, fadlan.

examples.en: I would like pilau and kachumbari.
examples.so: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa pilau iyo kachumbari.

title.so: Waxa la jecel yahay iyo waxa aan la jeclayn

body.en: Napenda means 'I like' (full form: ninapenda). To say 'I don't like', start with si- and change the final -a to -i: Sipendi. The same pattern turns kula (to eat) into Sili (I don't eat). Ask someone with Unapenda...? (Do you like...?).
body.so: Napenda waxay ka dhigan tahay 'waan jeclahay' (qaabka buuxa: ninapenda). Si aad u tiraahdo 'ma jecli', ku bilow si- oo -a dhammaadka u beddel -i: Sipendi. Isla qaabkaas ayaa kula (cunid) ka dhiga Sili (ma cuno). Qof weydii adigoo leh Unapenda...? (Ma jeceshahay...?).

title.en: Kenya vs Tanzania at the table

body.en: Kenyans say mandazi and samosa; in Tanzania you will hear maandazi and sambusa. Chips are chips in Kenya and chipsi in Tanzania. The Kenyan hoteli is called mgahawa (restaurant) in textbook Swahili.
body.so: Kenyaanku waxay yiraahdaan mandazi iyo samosa; Tanzania waxaad maqli doontaa maandazi iyo sambusa. Chips Kenya waa chips, Tanzania-na waa chipsi. Hoteli-da Kenya, Sawaaxiliga buugaagta waxaa lagu yiraahdaa mgahawa (makhaayad).

body.en: Many hotelis in Eastleigh, Garissa and Mombasa are Muslim-run and show a Halal sign. Elsewhere, ask Nyama hii ni halali? (Is this meat halal?). Street snacks like smokies and mutura are usually not halal.
body.so: Hoteliyo badan oo Eastleigh, Garissa iyo Mombasa ku yaal waxaa maamula Muslimiin, waxayna dhigaan calaamadda Halal. Meelaha kale, weydii Nyama hii ni halali? (Hilibkan xalaal ma yahay?). Cuntada fudud ee waddooyinka sida smokie iyo mutura badanaa xalaal ma aha.

examples.en: Excuse me, is this meat halal?
examples.so: Iga raalli ahaw, hilibkan xalaal ma yahay?

note.en: Eaten with the right hand, with stew or greens.
note.so: Waxaa lagu cunaa gacanta midig, maraq ama khudaar la jira.

items.so: sukuma wiki (caleen cagaaran oo la kariyey)

note.en: Literally 'push the week': cheap greens that get you to the end of the week.
note.so: Macnaha erayga waa 'toddobaadka riix': caleen jaban oo kuu gudbisa dhammaadka toddobaadka.

note.en: Usually goat or beef, shared with friends and eaten with kachumbari.
note.so: Badanaa waa hilib ari ama lo', saaxiibbo ayaa wadaaga, waxaana lagu cunaa kachumbari.

items.so: githeri (galley iyo digir la isku kariyey)

note.en: A Gikuyu word now used all over Kenya. A common school lunch.
note.so: Eray Gikuyu ah oo hadda Kenya oo dhan laga isticmaalo. Waa qado caadi ah oo iskuulada laga cuno.

note.en: A coastal dish now loved all over Kenya, cooked for weddings and Idd.
note.so: Cunto xeebta ka timid oo hadda Kenya oo dhan laga jecel yahay; waxaa loo kariyaa arrooska iyo Ciidda.

note.en: Uncooked rice is mchele.
note.so: Bariiska aan la karin waa mchele.

note.en: Popular in western Kenya and Kisii. Cooked as a stew, not eaten sweet.
note.so: Aad loogu jecel yahay galbeedka Kenya iyo Kisii. Waxaa loo kariyaa maraq ahaan, looma cuno sida muus macaan.

note.en: Tilapia from Lake Victoria (ngege) is famous in Kisumu.
note.so: Kalluunka tilapia ee Harada Fiktooriya (ngege) wuxuu caan ku yahay Kisumu.

note.en: Kuku kienyeji is free-range village chicken, a favourite.
note.so: Kuku kienyeji waa digaag tuulo oo xor u daaqa, aad baana loo jecel yahay.

note.en: Kenyan chai is usually boiled with milk and sugar.
note.so: Shaaha Kenya badanaa waxaa lagu kariyaa caano iyo sonkor.

note.en: Kenyans call any fizzy drink soda.
note.so: Kenyaanku cabitaan kasta oo hawo leh waxay ugu yeeraan soda.

note.en: The classic breakfast with chai.
note.so: Waa quraacda caadiga ah ee shaaha lala cuno.

note.en: A small roadside stall selling cheap food and tea.
note.so: Dukaan yar oo waddada dhinaceeda ah oo iibiya cunto jaban iyo shaah.

note.en: To call the waiter, Kenyans usually just say Samahani!
note.so: Si loogu yeero adeegaha, Kenyaanku badanaa waxay iska yiraahdaan Samahani!

items.en: What do you have today? (lit. What is there today?)

note.en: Nipe (give me) is a normal way to order in Kenya. Add tafadhali to be polite.
note.so: Nipe (i sii) waa hab caadi ah oo Kenya wax loogu dalbado. Ku dar tafadhali si aad edeb u muujiso.

items.en: Pack it for me (to take away)

note.en: Lit. 'tie it up for me'. You will also hear take away.
note.so: Macnaha erayga waa 'ii xidh'. Sidoo kale waxaad maqli doontaa take away.

note.en: Kenyans invite anyone who arrives while they are eating. A polite reply is Asante, nimeshiba.
note.so: Kenyaanku waxay ku casuumaan qof kasta oo yimaada iyagoo wax cunaya. Jawaab edeb leh waa Asante, nimeshiba.

note.en: -tamu means sweet or tasty. With chakula it becomes kitamu.
note.so: -tamu waxay ka dhigan tahay macaan ama dhadhan fiican. Marka la raaciyo chakula waxay noqotaa kitamu.

note.en: Also written bill. Bili, tafadhali = The bill, please.
note.so: Sidoo kale waxaa loo qoraa bill. Bili, tafadhali = Biilka, fadlan.

items.so: smokie pasua (sausage la kala jeexay oo kachumbari lagu shubay)

note.en: A smokie is a small smoked sausage; pasua means 'split'. Sold from carts all over Nairobi. Many smokies contain pork.
note.so: Smokie waa sausage yar oo qiiq lagu bislaaday; pasua waxay ka dhigan tahay 'kala jeex'. Waxaa laga iibiyaa gaari-gacan Nairobi oo dhan. Smokie badan waxaa ku jira hilib doofaar.

items.so: mutura (sausage Kenyan ah oo la dubay)

note.en: Goat intestines stuffed with meat and blood, grilled by the roadside in the evening. Not halal.
note.so: Xiidmaha ariga oo lagu buuxiyey hilib iyo dhiig, fiidkii waddada dhinaceeda ayaa lagu dubaa. Xalaal ma aha.

note.en: Grilled on charcoal and rubbed with lemon and chilli.
note.so: Dhuxul ayaa lagu dubaa, waxaana lagu marsadaa liin iyo basbaas.

meaning.en: We're eating ugali and sukuma wiki today.
meaning.so: Maanta waxaan cunaynaa ugali iyo sukuma wiki.

explain.en: 'Welcome! What are you eating today?' – 'Nyama choma and chapati.'
explain.so: 'Soo dhowow! Maanta maxaad cunaysaa?' – 'Hilib la dubay iyo sabaayad.'

explain.en: 'Do you want pilau or plain rice?' – 'Pilau, please.'
explain.so: 'Ma rabtaa pilau mise bariis caadi ah?' – 'Pilau, fadlan.'

explain.en: 'Shall I bring you tea?' – 'No, coffee please.'

lines.en: Welcome, sister! What can I bring you?
lines.so: Soo dhowow, walaal! Maxaan kuu keenaa?
Waxaa jira pilau, sabaayad iyo kalluun.

lines.en: I'd like pilau and kachumbari, please.
lines.so: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa pilau iyo kachumbari, fadlan.

lines.en: No, thanks. Give me a soda.

explain.en: 'Will you eat here or shall I pack it for you?' – 'Pack it for me, please.'
explain.so: 'Halkan ma ku cunaysaa mise waan kuu duubaa?' – 'Ii duub, fadlan.'

lines.sw: Karibu tule. Kuna ugali na samaki.
lines.en: Come and eat with us. There's ugali and fish.
lines.so: Kaalay aan wada cunno. Waxaa jira ugali iyo kalluun.

lines.en: Thanks! The food is very tasty.
lines.so: Mahadsanid! Cuntadu aad bay u macaan tahay.

explain.en: 'Come and eat with us!' – 'Thank you, I'm full.' A polite way to say no.
explain.so: 'Kaalay aan wada cunno!' – 'Mahadsanid, waan dhergay.' Hab edeb leh oo lagu diido.

meaning.en: I'm thirsty. Give me water, please.
meaning.so: Waan harraadsanahay. Biyo i sii, fadlan.

explain.en: 'Do you like nyama choma?' – 'Yes, I like it a lot!'
explain.so: 'Hilib la dubay ma jeceshahay?' – 'Haa, aad baan u jeclahay!'

meaning.en: I don't like coffee, I like tea.
meaning.so: Qaxwo ma jecli, shaah baan jeclahay.

lines.en: Excuse me, is this meat halal?
lines.so: Iga raalli ahaw, hilibkan xalaal ma yahay?

lines.sw: Ndiyo, mama. Hapa kila kitu ni halali.
lines.en: Yes, madam. Everything here is halal.
lines.so: Haa, hooyo. Halkan wax walba waa xalaal.

lines.sw: Asante. Nipe nyama choma na chapati mbili.
lines.en: Thank you. Give me nyama choma and two chapatis.
lines.so: Mahadsanid. I sii hilib la dubay iyo laba sabaayadood.

explain.so: 'Galley la dubay, labaatan (shilin)!' – 'Hagaag, mid i sii.'

meaning.en: In the evening we buy roast maize by the road.
meaning.so: Fiidkii waxaan iibsannaa galley la dubay oo waddada dhinaceeda laga iibiyo.
